Celebrating Aerial Filmmaking in Nepal

The Drone Film Festival 2026 set out to capture Nepal like never before, bringing aerial filmmaking and the country's drone community together for the first festival of its kind in Nepal. It was held on 25 July 2026 at Gokarna Forest Resort, Kathmandu.

UDAAN supported the festival as a partner. Following the event, the organisers, Drone Film Festival Nepal, publicly thanked UDAAN as a valued partner whose support and trust played an important role in making the festival possible.

“Your support and trust have played an important role in making this event possible.”

— Drone Film Festival Nepal

Why It Matters

Aerial cinematography is one of the fastest-growing uses of drones in Nepal. UDAAN works to make that growth safe and professional, from technically supervising the Film Development Board's drone training to advocating for clear, fair rules for drone operators.

UDAAN thanks the organisers and looks forward to creating many more milestones together with Nepal's drone filmmaking community.
